title: Why Are Emulators Legal? Dolphin vs. Nintendo, and the Fate of Emulation [Great Emu War Pt. 1]
summary: Moon Channel, run by a lawyer, explains the legal basis for emulation, including the history of emulation case law and Nintendo's takedown of Dolphin's Steam release. It argues the legality of emulators is more fragile than most people assume.
why: HN points to it as a clear, lawyer-made summary during Nintendo emulator disputes like Yuzu.

quote.text: I really recommend folks watch this, from a lawyer
